## Research Interests

- High-dimensional sampling, probability flows, and optimal transport, including regularized Wasserstein proximal methods and Fokker–Planck equations.
- Inverse problems and computational imaging, with an emphasis on inverse scattering, wave-based sensing, and limited or phaseless measurements.
- Scientific machine learning and optimization, including structured generative models, transformer architectures, and derivative-free methods.
- Scalable numerical computation using tensor methods, kernel representations, and particle algorithms.
